cases.prompt: Create a monthly revenue trend chart with six months of data.
expected: Select a line chart and consult demo/frmExample001.bas.
Use the SithasoMPACharts DataSet API.
Keep month labels in the same order as values.
Do not claim compilation unless performed.

cases.prompt: Compare monthly energy generated in kWh with revenue in rand on one chart.
expected: Recognize different units and discuss dual-axis trade-offs.
Consult demo/frmExample037.bas.
Assign the appropriate dataset to the right axis only after verifying the exact API.
Explain both axis units.

cases.prompt: Show live sensor readings updating every second.
expected: Consult demo/frmExample054.bas.
Use bounded visible history and avoid unbounded data growth.
Stop or disable timer work when the Activity is paused or destroyed.
Do not assume the demo's 60 ms interval is suitable.

cases.prompt: Create a candlestick chart from open, high, low and close price data.
expected: Consult demo/frmExample010.bas.
Preserve the wrapper's High, Low, Open, Close argument order.
Do not silently reorder the source data fields.

cases.prompt: Build a radial gauge with a center image and end labels.
expected: Consult examples 109–119 and inspect the relevant center-image and end-label examples.
Check Chart.GetVersion and the installed XML for version gates.
Do not claim support solely from the v10.19 handbook.

cases.prompt: Use MPAndroidChart's native Java API directly to set a custom marker on the wrapper.
expected: Explain that raw engine methods are not automatically exposed by the B4A wrapper.
Inspect the installed XML and examples for a supported wrapper method.
Do not invent a wrapper method or assume a JavaObject escape hatch is safe.

cases.prompt: I have 30 categories and need to compare each category's value.
expected: Recommend a horizontal bar chart as a candidate for many category labels.
Consult demo/frmExample004.bas.
Mention sorting and label legibility.

cases.prompt: Design a mobile chart comparing daily solar energy in kWh with daily income in rand.
expected: Enter Chart Architect mode and define the viewer question and data grain.
Identify unit mismatch and discuss separate charts versus dual axes.
Specify axis labels, dataset mapping and mobile readability.
Identify demo/frmExample037.bas as a reference without assuming every detail is verified.

cases.prompt: Plot market share percentages for 18 competitors in a pie chart.
expected: Challenge the pie chart choice because many slices are difficult to compare.
Recommend a ranked horizontal bar chart as a clearer candidate.
Confirm whether percentages share a common denominator and sum meaningfully.
Do not silently omit small competitors or convert missing values to zero.

cases.prompt: Create a dashboard chart with 48 hourly labels for a phone screen.
expected: Address label density and narrow portrait viewport constraints.
Consider fewer ticks, aggregation or horizontal scrolling only if supported and appropriate.
Avoid relying on excessive label rotation as the only solution.
Keep the data's time ordering intact.

cases.prompt: I placed the SithasoMPACharts view in the Visual Designer. Give me code to initialize and add another chart to the Activity.
expected: Clarify whether a second chart is actually intended.
Avoid duplicate initialization/attachment of the Designer-created chart.
Use the generated Designer member for the existing chart.

cases.prompt: Audit this code, but I cannot provide my installed XML or library version.
expected: Audit source-grounded behavior while marking target-installation API checks as unavailable.
Separate confirmed defects from risks and assumptions.
Do not label wrapper methods invalid without inspecting the target XML/source.
Provide the specific evidence and tests needed to close uncertainty.
